d:
Mr. Charlie makes two pizzas that look just like planet Earth! But how will he split them for four kids? With a line of ketchup for the Equator, he cuts the first pizza into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Then he draws the Prime Meridian and cuts the second into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. Geography has never tasted so good! Would you like Northern or Southern, Cussly?
In this episode, kids learn:
• What the Equator is (zero degrees latitude)
• The Northern and Southern Hemispheres, and which continents are in each
